cases.challenge: Unusual pipe-delimited line items with the charge in the final column
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1001
Description | Qty | Rate | Amount (INR)
Room charge | 4 days | 5000 | 20000
Pharmacy supplies | 1 | 1800 | 1800
Sub Total | 21800
Grand Total | 21800
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1001
Bill Total: INR 21800
Amount Paid: INR 21800
cases.hand_label: The total is 20,000 + 1,800 = INR 21,800; the final Amount column is the charge for each row.

cases.challenge: OCR-like character noise in a diagnostic row, with a readable total
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim Ref: ADV-1002
D1agn0stic invest1gations 1 2400 2400
Pharmacy 1 600 600
GRAND TOTAL INR 3000
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE

cases.challenge: Low-resolution scanned bill page with a date and total
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No. ADV-1003
Date: 10 Aug 2026
Room charges INR 12000
Lab tests INR 2500
Grand Total INR 14500
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No. ADV-1003
Bill Total INR 14500
Amount Paid INR 14500
cases.hand_label: INR 12,000 + INR 2,500 = INR 14,500; the date printed on the scan is 10 Aug 2026. OCR uncertainty is a review signal, not an arithmetic change.

cases.challenge: Settlement mentions an amount due after adjudication without saying it was paid
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1004
Consultation INR 1200
Medicines INR 3800
Grand Total INR 5000
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1004
Bill Total INR 5000
Amount due after adjudication: INR 4200
cases.hand_label: ‘Amount due after adjudication’ does not establish an actual payment; do not infer paid amount INR 4,200. Manual review is required.

cases.challenge: Room charge exactly equals a daily cap over four days
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1005
Room tariff | 4 days | INR 5000/day | INR 20000
Grand Total INR 20000
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1005
Bill Total INR 20000
Room rent deduction INR 0
Amount Paid INR 20000
cases.hand_label: INR 5,000 per day × 4 days = INR 20,000, exactly the billed room charge; allowable amount is INR 20,000 and room-cap deduction is zero.

cases.challenge: Room charge is one rupee above the four-day cap
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1006
Room charges for 4 days INR 20001
Grand Total INR 20001
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1006
Bill Total INR 20001
Room rent above limit INR 1
Amount Paid INR 20000
cases.hand_label: INR 5,000 × 4 = INR 20,000 allowed; INR 20,001 − INR 20,000 = INR 1 above the cap.

cases.challenge: Three separate settlement deductions with a reconciled payment
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1007
Room charges INR 25000
Medicines INR 4000
Lab tests INR 1000
Grand Total INR 30000
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1007
Bill Total INR 30000
Deductions:
Room rent | INR 5000 | above cap
Co-pay | INR 2000 | 10 percent
Non-medical items | INR 1000 | excluded
Amount Paid to Hospital INR 22000
cases.hand_label: INR 30,000 − INR 5,000 − INR 2,000 − INR 1,000 = INR 22,000 paid; all three deductions remain separate.

cases.challenge: Bill is complete but the settlement letter omits its claim reference
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1008
Emergency care INR 7000
Grand Total INR 7000
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Bill Total INR 7000
Amount paid INR 7000
cases.hand_label: The settlement has a payment matching the bill total, but without a claim reference it cannot be safely bound to this claim.

cases.challenge: Subtotal, tax, and grand total appear together
cases.bill_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1009
Nursing charges INR 18000
Lab tests INR 13000
Sub Total INR 31000
Tax INR 1550
Grand Total INR 32550
cases.settlement_text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE
Claim No: ADV-1009
Bill Total INR 32550
Amount Paid INR 32550
cases.hand_label: The subtotal is INR 31,000; adding INR 1,550 tax gives the explicit INR 32,550 Grand Total, which is the bill total.

Claim No: CLM-2026-0417
